properties.displayName: UAV S23 - GNSS Jamming (Loss of Control/Availability)
properties.description: UAVDatalinkConn_CL의 JamIndicator가 UAV_Threshold_List의 MaxJamIndicator를 초과하고 동시에 LinkState가 Degraded/Lost인 경우 GNSS 재밍으로 인한 통제·가용성 상실로 탐지. 임계값은 Watchlist로 동적 산출. MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0814(Denial of Service), T0813(Denial of Control), T0827(Loss of Control) / MITRE: T1498(근접기법)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let jamGate = toscalar(_GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List') | where ThresholdKey == 'MaxJamIndicator' | project todouble(Value) | take 1);
UAVDatalinkConn_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where isnotempty(UAVId)
| where JamIndicator > jamGate
| where LinkState in ('Degraded', 'Lost')
| extend TriggerReason = strcat('GNSS_재밍_통제가용성상실_JamIndicator:', tostring(JamIndicator), '_LinkState:', LinkState)
| extend Severity = iff(LinkState == 'Lost', 'High', 'Medium')
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, JamIndicator, LinkState, ChannelId, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S23 - GNSS Jamming (Loss of Control/Availability) - {{UAVId}}
